name: fmcad
description: Standalone API, CLI, MCP server, and optional OpenCode plugin for Autodesk Fusion.

scripts.build: npm run build:code && node dist/scripts/adsk-refresh/cli.js --pinned scripts/adsk-refresh/api-lock.json dist/runtime/python/typing && node scripts/stage-core.cjs --identity-only
scripts.build:code: tsc -b tsconfig.json && tsc -p scripts/adsk-refresh/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.api.json && tsc -p tsconfig.devtools.json && node dist/scripts/devtools/stage-queue-runtime.js && node scripts/stage-core.cjs && node --test tests/devtools/*.test.js && npm run build:opencode && npm run build:console-browser && node scripts/stage-core.cjs --identity-only && tsc -p tsconfig.runtime-tests.json && node dist/scripts/devtools/stage-queue-runtime.js --tests && npm run build:docs
scripts.build:opencode: tsc -p tsconfig.opencode.json && node scripts/stage-opencode.cjs && node scripts/stage-core.cjs --identity-only
scripts.build:dev: npm run build:code && node dist/scripts/adsk-refresh/cli.js --dev dist/runtime/python/typing && node scripts/stage-core.cjs --identity-only
scripts.format: prettier --write --end-of-line auto package.json .github/workflows/ci.yml tsconfig.api.json tsconfig.runtime-tests.json src/composition/opencode.ts src/composition/control-center.ts packages/control-center/package.json packages/control-center/tsconfig.json packages/control-center/tsconfig.browser.json packages/control-center/scripts/build-browser.cjs "packages/control-center/src/**/*.ts" packages/opencode-adapter/src/shared/contracts.ts packages/opencode-adapter/src/shared/ensure-web.ts packages/opencode-adapter/src/v1/index.ts packages/opencode-adapter/src/v2/index.ts src/entrypoints/queue-autostart.ts src/entrypoints/queue-connection.ts src/entrypoints/queue-preflight.ts src/queue-autostart.js src/queue-connection.js src/queue-preflight.js tests/control-center-agents-projects.test.ts tests/control-center-test-support.ts tests/project-history-store.test.ts tests/control-center-browser-e2e.test.mts tests/control-center-browser-fixture.mts tests/catalog-worker.test.ts tests/fusion-transport-broker.test.ts tests/mcp-stdio-catalog-sharing.test.js tests/control-center-browser-bundle.test.js tests/control-center-root-composition.test.js tests/control-center-root-service.test.js tests/fixtures/fake-wsl-platform.cjs tests/mcp-owned-result-root.test.js tests/opencode-web-ensure.test.js tests/phased-queue.test.ts tests/queue-preflight.test.js tests/runtime-artifact.test.ts tests/runtime-test-environment.ts tests/live-data-import.ts tests/live-data-import-fixed.ts tests/live-import-receipts.ts tests/live-import-receipt.test.ts tests/fixed-import-checker.test.ts tests/fixed-native-program-source.test.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --end-of-line auto package.json .github/workflows/ci.yml tsconfig.api.json tsconfig.runtime-tests.json src/composition/opencode.ts src/composition/control-center.ts packages/control-center/package.json packages/control-center/tsconfig.json packages/control-center/tsconfig.browser.json packages/control-center/scripts/build-browser.cjs "packages/control-center/src/**/*.ts" packages/opencode-adapter/src/shared/contracts.ts packages/opencode-adapter/src/shared/ensure-web.ts packages/opencode-adapter/src/v1/index.ts packages/opencode-adapter/src/v2/index.ts src/entrypoints/queue-autostart.ts src/entrypoints/queue-connection.ts src/entrypoints/queue-preflight.ts src/queue-autostart.js src/queue-connection.js src/queue-preflight.js tests/control-center-agents-projects.test.ts tests/control-center-test-support.ts tests/project-history-store.test.ts tests/control-center-browser-e2e.test.mts tests/control-center-browser-fixture.mts tests/catalog-worker.test.ts tests/fusion-transport-broker.test.ts tests/mcp-stdio-catalog-sharing.test.js tests/control-center-browser-bundle.test.js tests/control-center-root-composition.test.js tests/control-center-root-service.test.js tests/fixtures/fake-wsl-platform.cjs tests/mcp-owned-result-root.test.js tests/opencode-web-ensure.test.js tests/phased-queue.test.ts tests/queue-preflight.test.js tests/runtime-artifact.test.ts tests/runtime-test-environment.ts tests/live-data-import.ts tests/live-data-import-fixed.ts tests/live-import-receipts.ts tests/live-import-receipt.test.ts tests/fixed-import-checker.test.ts tests/fixed-native-program-source.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck:tests && node --test tests/*.test.js && npm run test:control-center:projects && npm run test:response-recovery && npm run test:import-contracts && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p '*_test.py'
scripts.test:contracts: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/broker-lifecycle.test.js tests/execution-worker-stages.test.js tests/fusion-reset.test.js tests/console-services.test.js tests/console-telemetry.test.js tests/console-pause.test.js tests/stage-journal.test.js tests/queue-preflight.test.js tests/library-api.test.js tests/mcp-framing.test.js tests/mcp-owned-result-root.test.js tests/mcp-stdio-catalog-sharing.test.js tests/control-center-root-composition.test.js tests/control-center-root-service.test.js tests/control-center-browser-bundle.test.js tests/workspace-toolchain.test.js tests/phased-queue.test.js tests/catalog-worker.test.js tests/fusion-transport-broker.test.js tests/runtime-artifact.test.js && npm run test:response-recovery && npm run test:control-center:projects
scripts.test:control-center:e2e: npm run build:code && npm run typecheck:tests && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/control-center-browser-e2e.test.mts
scripts.test:workspace: npm run build:code && npm run typecheck:tests && node --test tests/workspace-toolchain.test.js
